description: This file manages tips and popups for the Notesnook mobile app, including tip selection, state management, and user interface interactions.

classes.name: TipManager
classes.description: Handles initialization, retrieval, and state management of tips and popups within the app.

methods.name: TipManager.init
methods.description: Initializes tip and popup states from persistent storage.

methods.name: TipManager.tip
methods.description: Retrieves a tip for a given context, ensuring destructive contexts are only shown once.

methods.name: TipManager.popup
methods.description: Finds a popup by its ID.

methods.name: TipManager.markPopupUsed
methods.description: Marks a popup as used in persistent storage.

methods.name: useTip
methods.description: Custom React hook to display tips based on context with optional rotation and delay.
